description: This Java class 'ResourceImportService' handles the import and synchronization of resource entities within the Thingsboard platform, including resource lookup, copying, cleanup, saving, and event handling.

classes.name: ResourceImportService
classes.description: A service class for importing and managing resource entities, extending base import functionality.

methods.name: setOwner
methods.description: Assigns the tenant ID to the resource.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the resource for import, currently returns the resource as-is.

methods.name: findExistingEntity
methods.description: Finds an existing resource by tenant ID and resource key or name.

methods.name: deepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the resource.

methods.name: cleanupForComparison
methods.description: Cleans up resource fields for comparison, such as nullifying search text and descriptor if null.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates the resource, handling image resources differently.

methods.name: onEntitySaved
methods.description: Handles post-save actions, such as notifying resource change.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is TB_RESOURCE.
